title: Bulk and single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses along with abundant machine learning methods identify a novel monocyte signature in SKCM.
authors: Liu, Yuyao; Zhang, Haoxue; Mao, Yan; Shi, Yangyang; Wang, Xu; Shi, Shaomin; Hu, Delin; Liu, Shengxiu
one_liner_zh: 该文基于bulk和单细胞RNA测序及机器学习构建皮肤黑色素瘤单核细胞预后签名，虽涉及转录因子调控网络但核心为预后标志物，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模与AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Global patterns of immune cell communications in the immune microenvironment of skin cutaneous melanoma (SKCM) haven't been well understood. Here we recognized signaling roles of immune cell populations and main contributive signals. We explored how multiple immune cells and signal paths coordinate with each other and established a prognosis signature based on the key specific biomarkers with cellular communication. METHODS: The single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) dataset was downloaded from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database, in which various immune cells were extracted and re-annotated according to cell markers defined in the original study to identify their specific signs. We computed immune-cell communication networks by calculating the linking number or summarizing the communication probability to visualize the cross-talk tendency in different immune cells. Combining abundant analyses of communication networks and identifications of communication modes, all networks were quantitatively characterized and compared. Based on the bulk RNA sequencing data, we trained specific markers of hub communication cells through integration programs of machine learning to develop new immune-related prognostic combinations. RESULTS: An eight-gene monocyte-related signature (MRS) has been built, confirmed as an independent risk factor for disease-specific survival (DSS). MRS has great predictive values in progression free survival (PFS) and possesses better accuracy than traditional clinical variables and molecular features. The low-risk group has better immune functions, infiltrated with more lymphocytes and M1 macrophages, with higher expressions of HLA, immune checkpoints, chemokines and costimulatory molecules. The pathway analysis based on seven databases confirms the biological uniqueness of the two risk groups. Additionally, the regulon activity profiles of 18 transcription factors highlight possible differential regulatory patterns between the two risk groups, suggesting epigenetic event-driven transcriptional networks may be an important distinction. MRS has been identified as a powerful tool to benefit SKCM patients. Moreover, the IFITM3 gene has been identified as the key gene, validated to express highly at the protein level via the immunohistochemical assay in SKCM. CONCLUSION: MRS is accurate and specific in evaluating SKCM patients' clinical outcomes. IFITM3 is a potential biomarker. Moreover, they are promising to improve the prognosis of SKCM patients.
abstract_zh: 背景：皮肤黑色素瘤（SKCM）免疫微环境中免疫细胞通讯的全局模式尚未被充分理解。在此，我们识别了免疫细胞群体的信号角色及主要贡献性信号。我们探讨了多种免疫细胞和信号通路如何相互协调，并基于具有细胞通讯的关键特异性生物标志物建立了一个预后特征。方法：单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据集从基因表达综合数据库（GEO）下载，其中提取了各种免疫细胞，并根据原始研究中定义的细胞标志物重新注释，以识别其特异性信号。我们通过计算连接数或汇总通讯概率来计算免疫细胞通讯网络，以可视化不同免疫细胞间的交互倾向。结合通讯网络的丰富分析和通讯模式的识别，所有网络均被定量表征和比较。基于批量RNA测序数据，我们通过机器学习整合程序训练枢纽通讯细胞的特异性标志物，以开发新的免疫相关预后组合。结果：构建了一个八基因单核细胞相关特征（MRS），并确认为疾病特异性生存（DSS）的独立风险因素。MRS在无进展生存（PFS）方面具有很高的预测价值，且比传统临床变量和分子特征具有更好的准确性。低风险组具有更好的免疫功能，浸润更多淋巴细胞和M1巨噬细胞，HLA、免疫检查点、趋化因子和共刺激分子表达更高。基于七个数据库的通路分析确认了两个风险组的生物学独特性。此外，18个转录因子的调节子活性谱突显了两个风险组之间可能的差异调控模式，提示表观遗传事件驱动的转录网络可能是一个重要区别。MRS已被确定为有益于SKCM患者的强大工具。此外，IFITM3基因被识别为关键基因，并通过免疫组织化学检测在SKCM中验证其在蛋白质水平高表达。结论：MRS在评估SKCM患者临床结局方面准确且特异。IFITM3是一个潜在生物标志物。此外，它们有望改善SKCM患者的预后。
